summary: Addex Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K reporting a USD 2.8 million (CHF 2.2 million) capital raise through its At-the-Market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co. The company sold 437,869 ADSs representing 52,544,280 ordinary shares. Proceeds extend the cash runway to Q4 2027. Outstanding shares increased to 210,292,217 while issued shares remained at 218,654,496. This is an equity financing event rather than a traditional special situation; the ATM sale provides dilution but no premium, board recommendation, or structural complexity. Watch for further ATM draws and cash runway updates.
